newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Electronics Q1 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Electronics Q1 net falls.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday its Hughes Electronics Corp subsidiary had first quarter net income of $235 million, down from $312 million a year earlier, which included an after-tax gain of $72 million.
Hughes's earnings fell to $0.59 per share of GM Class H stock, from $0.78.
The special gain in the 1996 first quarter resulted from Hughes's sale of a 2.5 percent interest in DirecTV to AT&T Corp.
GM has agreed to sell Hughes's defense-related businesses to Raytheon Co in a deal valued at about $9.5 billion. The transaction is expected to close in the third quarter.
